title: Website Policies
text:
# Website Policies
The content in this website and associated portals is the result of a collaborative effort of various divisions of UIDAI. It is our endeavour to continue the enhancement and enrichment of this website and portals in terms of content coverage, design and technology on a regular basis. For any query or suggestion regarding website content send email to -  
Web Information Manager  
UIDAI Website & Portals  
Praveen Chaudhary  
Director (Media)  
Bangla Sahib Road, Behind Kali Mandir  
Gole Market, New Delhi: 110001  
Email: webadmin[-]uidai[@]nic[.]in. This website and associated portals (including myAadhaar) are designed, developed, maintained and their content provided by the UIDAI. Though all efforts have been made to ensure the accuracy and correctness of the content on this website and associated portals, the same should not be construed as a statement of law or used for any legal purposes. In case of any ambiguity or doubts, users are advised to send email to webadmin[-]uidai[@]nic[.]in or verify/check with the concerned divisions given in the Contact section of this website to obtain appropriate professional advice. In addition to informational content, UIDAI provides Aadhaar-related services through its associated portals (such as myAadhaar). Access to such services may require user authentication through OTP or other secure mechanisms. Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials and ensuring secure access while using these services. Users shall not attempt to misuse, disrupt, or compromise the security of the website or associated portals. Any unauthorized attempt to access, modify, or misuse data may lead to appropriate legal action as per applicable laws. Under no circumstances will this Department (UIDAI) be liable for any expense, loss or damage including, but not without limited indirect or consequential loss or damage, or any expense, whatsoever arising from use or loss of use of data, arising out of or in connection with the use of the contents of this website or associated portals. A. INTRODUCTION
I. UIDAI is a statutory authority established and governed under the provisions of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits, and Services) Act, 2016 (as amended), along with the regulations framed thereunder. I. Certain features and services on the Platforms (including myAadhaar portal) may require you to provide personal information, including 'Personally Identifiable Information'. II. If you do not wish to use these specific features or services, UIDAI will only collect non-personal information such as usage logs and technical data. III. You are responsible for ensuring the correctness and accuracy of the Personally Identifiable Information you submit on any of our Platforms. Providing inaccurate information may affect your ability to access or use the Platform(s). C. INFORMATION COLLECTION
